content: When I dare to be powerful, to use my strength in the service of my vision, then it becomes less and less important whether I am afraid.
author: Audre Lorde
story:
Preserved as part of Audre Lorde's enduring intellectual legacy, this reflection addresses the fundamental nature of power and courage. Across his life and work, Audre Lorde returned repeatedly to the conviction that personal integrity, honest observation, and clarity of purpose are the foundational pillars of a life well-lived.

Contemplating this truth invites us to step back from the frantic rush of daily demands. By examining our assumptions with fresh eyes, we discover the inner grounding necessary to act with wisdom and quiet conviction.
reflectionPrompt: Where does your life require a quiet act of courage from you before this week ends?
